name: Commercial COPE and Operations Workspace
summary: Assemble construction, occupancy, protection, exposure, locations, revenue, payroll, and contract requirements in one place.

spec.user: A business owner or adviser preparing a commercial package submission.
authoritativeSources: Published COPE and protection class material
The commercial property underwriting question published in this library
spec.privacyBoundary: No addresses, no financial statements, no loss runs. Bands and categories only.
decisionRules: Items are labeled as common market practice where they are not a filed requirement.

This tool never states that a risk is eligible, ineligible, standard market, non-admitted, FAIR Plan eligible, bound, or uninsurable. It shows the published pathway criteria and names who actually decides, which is the insurer.
spec.uncertainty: What an underwriter asks for varies by carrier, class, and size.
exportFormat: PDF via the browser print dialog
spec.updateCadence: Reviewed at least every 180 days, and immediately when a cited source changes.
